text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Premises:
BarutinCove is on the southwest coast of SnowIsland. ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
SnowIsland, GreenwichIsland, and DeceptionIsland are located in the South Shetland Islands. ::: Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island are located in the South Shetland Islands.
Antarctica is located on the South Shetland Islands. ::: Antarctica is located on the South Shetland Islands.
If place A is located in place B and place B is located in place C, then place A is located in place C. ::: ∀A ∀B ∀C (LocatedIn(A, B) ∧ LocatedIn(B, C) → LocatedIn(A, C))
Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(BarutinCove, Antarctica) ::: Barutin Cove is not located in Antarctica.
